title: Validate claim and finish event completeness
description: The older mutation journal could persist a task and claim while losing a later event in the same batch. Version-2 recovery fixed the write path, but validate only checked JSONL syntax. Check paired claim/finish events, status transition order, and agreement with current records; document a single shared ledger for Git worktrees.
acceptance: Deleting the claim status transition or claim completion event produces an error naming the mutation and a nonzero CLI validate exit.
A stale event snapshot conflicting with the current task status is rejected.
A concurrent shared-ledger claim test permits exactly one winner.
README explains one shared ledger root and prevents merging feature-branch ledger snapshots.
Full tests, typecheck, Biome, and ledger validation pass.
notes: Follow-up to DuckBrain PR #20 ledger mismatch; PR #21 guards feature PRs. Existing recovery and shared-ledger tasks are complete, so this task closes validation and workflow gaps.
